content:
anya: Heads-up — thinking about default trace-log linking behavior for private workspaces. Proposal: default OFF (no trace_id in logs), opt-in per-workspace or per-service; three modes: agent, ingest, in-app. Thoughts?

kevin: +1 to making it opt-in. Practical tradeoffs: ingest-linking (extract trace_id from spans/OTLP at collector) is easiest for customers but means we index trace keys in our logs pipeline — costs/retention impact.

carla: we need consent/PII review. If trace ids are considered user identifiers for some customers, we should allow 'no-linking' and a hashed mode.

mike: SDK suggestion — add `redwood.tracing.mode` config: `none|hashed|raw_ingest|raw_agent`. Default `none`. If `hashed` we store H(trace_id) to keep correlation but reduce sharing risk.

platform-eng: console UX: toggles per-workspace with a small banner explaining cost/retention. Also add rollout controls: start disabled for new workspaces, opt-in prompt during onboarding.

kevin: implement collector transform that can emit `rw.trace_hash` and only index that field when workspace setting allows. Example OTEL processor:

```
processors:
  trace_hash:
    type: extract_trace_to_attribute
    attribute: rw.trace_hash
    hash: sha256
```

carla: what about cross-service linking when apps use 3rd-party log libs? We should support ingest lookup by span_id from OTLP traces and attach in logs during ingest.

mike: header idea: `x-rw-trace` for HTTP requests. If present, SDKs propagate it. But default SDKs won't inject it unless tracing enabled.

sre-bot: warning — indexing `rw.trace_hash` will spike unique field cardinality. Recommend sampling 1% by default + allow sampling rules per workspace.

anya: summary — PR incoming: collector processor + console flag + SDK opt-in + sampling defaults. Will post RFC and rollout plan. @kevin @carla please review.

kevin: ack, happy to review.

carla: ack, add compliance checklist.

platform-eng: I'll mock the console copy.

mike: can we include an opt-out webhook for customers to confirm they decline?

anya: sure — add to RFC. Thanks all :thumbsup:
